heroHeadline: CCG 4305 Withdraws After 3-Day Zambales EEZ Patrol; Xiang Yang Hong 33 Persists Near Pag-asa — Day 15; Beijing's Silence on Note Verbale Enters 10th Day
heroSubtitle: China Coast Guard vessel CCG 4305 withdrew from the Philippine Exclusive Economic Zone off Zambales on May 21, 2026, after a three-day unauthorized patrol (May 19-21) that began when Canada's Dark Vessel Detection Program flagged it approximately 48 nautical miles west of Pandaquit, Zambales. PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan's deployment of BRP Cape San Agustin and sustained radio challenges by PCG aircraft — including Piper Navajo 302 — produced the departure without kinetic escalation. However, the CCG 4305's withdrawal reduces China's concurrent West Philippine Sea pressure from four simultaneous fronts to three: (1) Xiang Yang Hong 33 research vessel (with CCG escorts 5101 and 5309) entered Day 15 of its unauthorized operations in the Kalayaan Island Group near Pag-asa (Thitu) Island, with no sign of departure — the research vessel moved from a Reed Bank EEZ violation (UNCLOS Article 246, May 7) to a direct territorial sea intrusion and personnel landing on Sandy Cay 2 and Sandy Cay 3 (May 16-17) that the PCG formally is investigating as a first-of-its-kind Chinese personnel landing on Philippine Spratly sandbars; (2) Scarborough Shoal — China's 'marine nature reserve' declaration and April floating barrier remain subject to a unanswered Philippine DFA protest from May 11; (3) Second Thomas Shoal — BRP Sierra Madre marine garrison faces continuing CCG blockade posture. Beijing's diplomatic silence on the Philippines' UNCLOS Article 246 note verbale entered its 10th consecutive day on May 21 — a record for unanswered Philippine diplomatic instruments under the Marcos administration. Former Justice Carpio's warning that the Pag-asa sandbar landing follows the civilian-to-military conversion playbook used at Fiery Cross and Subi Reef continues to shape Philippine national security discourse about the appropriate escalatory response threshold.
